blurb: Guests fish for crappie and a variety of species using multiple presentation methods including long poles, slipcorks, minnows, spoons, jigs, swimbaits, topwater lures, crankbaits, and A-rigs. Trips start at first light and include picture taking and fish filleting as part of the fishing time. The guide has extensive experience and Coast Guard approved Captain credentials for all U.S. inland waters.
extraNote: Reservations made in order payment or deposit is received · $300 deposit required to reserve any trip · Cancellations less than 4 days prior charged minimum daily rate of $600
